sv.title: Hon miljonköper i kycklingbolagets kursfall
sv.summary: Anna Qviberg Engebretsen, dotter till Öresunds huvudägare Mats Qviberg, har köpt fler aktier i kycklingbolaget Scandi Standard under tisdagens kursfall.

en.title: She buys millions worth of shares in the chicken company's share slump
en.summary: Anna Qviberg Engebretsen, daughter of Öresund's main owner Mats Qviberg, has bought more shares in the chicken company Scandi Standard during Tuesday's share price drop.
